verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover every rule type in the story. Natural-language rules come through path instructions scoped by glob (docs-8, docs-48) and chat-taught learnings applied to future reviews (docs-7, docs-51). Structural rules come through ast-grep AST patterns (docs-9, docs-49), and in-repo guideline files such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are auto-detected and applied as review criteria (docs-10). Org-wide rules live in a central .coderabbit.yaml (docs-14), and the request-changes workflow can block PRs on actionable findings (supp-4, docs-47). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that custom rules are reliably enforced in practice, and explicit documentation for linking external style-guide URLs; MCP docs sources (docs-12) are only an indirect substitute.
